data.one_liner: Convert between UTM, DMS, and DD geographic coordinates using the WGS84 model.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes and methods to convert geographic coordinates between UTM (Universal Transverse Mercator), DMS (Degrees, Minutes and Seconds), and DD (Decimal Degrees) formats within the WGS84 ellipsoid model. Supports both static methods and instance-based conversions in Dart.
use_when: You need to transform GPS coordinates between Decimal Degrees, DMS, and UTM formats.
Your application works with maps or spatial data requiring coordinate system conversions.
avoid_when: You need map rendering, geolocation streaming, or geofencing features rather than coordinate math.
strengths: Supports multiple coordinate formats (UTM, DMS, DD).
Compatible with both Flutter and pure Dart projects.
Provides both static conversion methods and convenient instance methods.
weaknesses: Limited to the WGS84 ellipsoid model.
Does not include visual map widgets or rendering tools.
